## Summary

I implemented F004 (simple worker role assignment) for plan 2026-05-30-001. I added a new pure module `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/role_assignment.py` that resolves the effective `implementer`/`auditor`/`goal_auditor` agent for each role **together with its source layer** (project roles, project legacy, global roles, global legacy, the `goal_auditor`→resolved-auditor fallthrough, or hardcoded fallback) — mirroring `config.resolvers.resolve_role`'s precedence exactly — plus a `dashboard_projection()` shape exposing available executors, effective roles with source/dispatchability, scope descriptors, and safe per-scope mutation command templates. I wired a `dontpanic roles show [--project NAME|PATH] [--json]` / `dontpanic roles set <role> <executor> [--global|--project NAME|PATH] [--dry-run] [--yes]` CLI surface into `cli.py`, reusing the shared dotted-key writers for global (`~/.dontpanic/config.json`) and project (`<repo>/.dontpanic/dontpanic.json`) writes and the existing `agent_surface.assert_registrable` guard so unknown executors (e.g. `Grok-Builder`) are refused with exit 3 and the operator-vs-worker wording *before* any write; I also added `roles` to the manifest's `supported_commands` and top-level help.
